candidates.title: Tutti: Making SSD-Backed KV Cache Practical for Long-Context LLM Serving
candidates.reason: GPU-centric NVMe KV-cache path with GPU io_uring and slack-aware I/O scheduling; directly relevant to SSD-backed inference and reports real vLLM integration, TTFT/request-rate/cost gains.

candidates.title: SwiftCache: Efficient LLM Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with Heterogeneous KV Cache Sharing
candidates.reason: Cross-model GPU-memory donation and NVLink KV sharing avoid CPU/SSD reloads while extending context length; strong heterogeneous-memory serving-system contribution with real-workload evaluation.

candidates.title: Robust KV Cache Management for LLM Serving under Output Token Length Uncertainty
candidates.reason: Joint KV reservation, serving-group configuration, routing and prefix caching under uncertain output lengths using distributionally robust optimization; reports trace-driven cost and SLO gains.
